features.name: area_sqm_z_clipped
features.description: Standardized living area using training-fold mean and spread, clipped to reduce the effect of extreme values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth primary size signal with bounded influence for a margin-based linear model.

features.name: area_log_scaled
features.description: Diminishing-return transform of recorded area, scaled by the training-fold maximum area.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures saturation in the usefulness of additional area while staying smooth and bounded.

features.name: room_count_z_clipped
features.description: Standardized room count using training-fold mean and spread, clipped for robust scaling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a compact layout-capacity signal that combines well with area features in a linear margin.

features.name: area_per_room_z_clipped
features.description: Square meters per room, centered by the ratio of training-fold mean area to mean room count and scaled by a broad room-size unit.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates spacious layouts from cramped layouts through a ratio that a purely linear combination cannot form by itself.

features.name: compact_area_issue_severity
features.description: Severity score for implausibly tiny recorded area; decreases linearly to zero at 20 square meters and above.
features.expected_model_benefit: Lets a linear margin isolate placeholder-size or unusually compact records without hard row removal.

features.name: floor_z_clipped
features.description: Standardized floor level using training-fold mean and spread, clipped for outlier control.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a smooth vertical-position signal that can align with building height and view-related effects.

features.name: floor_log_scaled
features.description: Monotone floor-level transform with diminishing incremental effect at high floors and safe handling of basement-like values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a bounded nonlinear floor signal that is easier for a linear SVM to use than raw floor alone.

features.name: location_code_z_clipped
features.description: Standardized location code using training-fold mean and spread.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized geographic-code signal when code ordering carries regional or neighborhood gradients.

features.name: title_signal_z_clipped
features.description: Standardized numeric title signal using training-fold mean and spread.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes listing-title magnitude or code intensity after normalization, enabling monotonic text-proxy effects.

features.name: scrape_time_scaled
features.description: Position of the row scrape time within the training-fold scrape-time window.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures smooth chronology effects and market drift using only the row timestamp and training-fold bounds.

features.name: location_desirability_judgment
features.description: Numeric assessment from row location information, and a training-fold codebook if available, of centrality, transit access, amenities, and neighborhood reputation; 0 means weak desirability and 1 means strong desirability. Use 0.5 when location is an opaque numeric code with no codebook.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth non-ordinal neighborhood quality input that can be weighted directly by a linear margin.

features.name: listing_appeal_judgment
features.description: Numeric assessment from row title information, or decoded title text from training-fold metadata if available, of appealing listing cues such as renovated condition, new construction, parking, view, furnishing, or premium finishes; 0 means weak appeal and 1 means strong appeal. Use 0.5 when title is an opaque numeric value with no decoding.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts qualitative marketing cues into a bounded score that a margin-based model can combine with numeric property attributes.
